label: sound
instruction_covers: ReporterList(reporters), set_batch_size, add_value with the stated defaults is_averaged=True, reduction=average, no_sync=False, and the add() and call aliases
is_averaged=True weights each value by the current batch size, and the stated loss and batch-size example lands at history['loss'][-1]
reduction sum sums the collected values, a callable reduction receives the list of values and its return becomes the epoch result, and any other reduction string raises ValueError
dictionary values are reduced per key and reported as grouped scalars; a one-element tensor result is sent as a scalar and a multi-element one as grouped scalars keyed by element index
report writes key/mode when mode is non-empty and key otherwise, calls add_scalar, add_scalars and flush, and a second report with no new values is a no-op
history supports both subscript and call access, and exit() clears the persistent history

add_text, add_figure, add_histogram with its bins argument, and add_image are forwarded, an image is min-max normalized when normalize=True, and a warning is raised when no backend supports the method
notes: History stores the reduced epoch result, so a multi-element tensor is kept as its list while the backend receives the dispatched grouped scalars; the instruction separates the epoch result from what is sent to backends, and the one-element case confirms history holds the result itself. The add_scalars index keys are compared after str(), so integer or string keys both pass. The instance-independence and leak-floor tests require only ordinary per-instance pending state plus exit() clearing history, which is the natural reading, and dict(history) works for the dict-like history the subscript interface implies.
